lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn2Co2Ge4 (reduced formula MnCoGe2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Mn each coordinated by eight Ge neighbors, while Ge centers have nine geometric neighbors (4 Co, 2 Mn, 3 Ge), with neighbor distances near 2.54–3.07 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Ge and Mn polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Ge polyhedra.
